lines.speaker: momo
lines.text: Can I ask you something about the blue sky?

lines.speaker: momo
lines.text: Why is the sky blue, Ravi?

lines.speaker: ravi
lines.text: Air scatters blue light more than reds and yellows, so blue reaches us from every direction.

lines.speaker: ravi
lines.text: At sunset the light crosses much more air. Even more of the blue is scattered away, and the reds and yellows come straight through. Big word, small idea.
